sentences.text: Day 1 Morning Routine The very first thing I do every morning is drink some water because I always wake up feeling a bit dehydrated.
sentences.text_ko: 아침에 일어나서 제가 제일 먼저 하는 건 물 한 잔 마시는 거예요. 자고 일어나면 항상 몸이 좀 말라 있거든요.

sentences.text: Then I squeeze some toothpaste onto my toothbrush and start brushing my teeth.
sentences.text_ko: 그다음엔 칫솔에 치약을 짜서 이를 닦기 시작해요.

sentences.text: After I brush my teeth, I do some light stretching.
sentences.text_ko: 양치가 끝나면 가볍게 스트레칭을 좀 해요.

sentences.text: I usually do simple stretches in the morning such as touching my toes or raising my arms above my head.
sentences.text_ko: 아침에는 보통 발끝을 만지거나 팔을 머리 위로 쭉 올리는 같은 간단한 스트레칭을 해요.

sentences.text: After about 5 minutes of stretching, I sit on the ground with my legs crossed to meditate.
sentences.text_ko: 스트레칭을 5분 정도 하고 나면 바닥에 앉아서 다리를 꼬고 명상을 해요.

sentences.text: While meditating, I close my eyes and rest my hands on my legs.
sentences.text_ko: 명상할 때는 눈을 감고 손은 다리 위에 올려둬요.

sentences.text: I try to sit very still and focus on my breath.
sentences.text_ko: 몸을 최대한 가만히 두고 호흡에 집중하려고 해요.

sentences.text: After that, it's time to make my bed.
I grab the comforter and spread it evenly across the bed.
sentences.text_ko: 이불을 잡아서 침대 위에 고르게 펴요.

sentences.text: I put the pillows on top and smooth out the comforter as much as possible so there aren't any wrinkles.
sentences.text_ko: 베개를 올리고 주름이 안 생기게 이불을 최대한 반듯하게 정리해요.

sentences.text: Next, I take a hot shower.
I dry off and wrap myself in a towel before picking out my clothes.
sentences.text_ko: 몸을 닦고 수건을 두른 다음에 입을 옷을 골라요.

sentences.text: I get dressed and then it's finally time for my favorite part of my morning routine, eating breakfast and drinking coffee.
sentences.text_ko: 옷을 입고 나면 드디어 아침 루틴 중에서 제일 좋아하는 시간이에요. 아침 먹고 커피 마시는 시간이죠.

sentences.text: Normally I cook breakfast, but every once in a while I order delivery from a local cafe in my neighborhood.
sentences.text_ko: 보통은 제가 직접 아침을 만들어 먹지만, 가끔은 동네 카페에서 배달을 시키기도 해요.

sentences.text: While eating breakfast, I usually read my book.
The very first thing I do every morning is drink some water because I always wake up feeling a bit dehydrated.
sentences.text_ko: 아침에 일어나서 제일 먼저 하는 건 역시 물 한 잔 마시는 거예요. 자고 나면 항상 좀 목이 마르거든요.

full_transcript: Day 1 Morning Routine The very first thing I do every morning is drink some water because I always wake up feeling a bit dehydrated. Then I squeeze some toothpaste onto my toothbrush and start brushing my teeth. After I brush my teeth, I do some light stretching. I usually do simple stretches in the morning such as touching my toes or raising my arms above my head. After about 5 minutes of stretching, I sit on the ground with my legs crossed to meditate. While meditating, I close my eyes and rest my hands on my legs. I try to sit very still and focus on my breath. After that, it's time to make my bed. I grab the comforter and spread it evenly across the bed. I put the pillows on top and smooth out the comforter as much as possible so there aren't any wrinkles. Next, I take a hot shower. I dry off and wrap myself in a towel before picking out my clothes. I get dressed and then it's finally time for my favorite part of my morning routine, eating breakfast and drinking coffee. Normally I cook breakfast, but every once in a while I order delivery from a local cafe in my neighborhood. While eating breakfast, I usually read my book.
